items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also includes fixes for other critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-153, this addresses a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8) in Adobe Commerce B2B that could lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, StyleSmuggler, CVSS 10.0) that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution and is known to be exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple stored cross-site scripting flaws, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves a critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) allowing unauthenticated privilege escalation, which has been added to the CISA KEV catalog.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this addresses a critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVE-2026-48413, CVSS 8.7) that may result in arbitrary code execution with a low-privileged authenticated account.
